answer: Anchor every new agent to a Wharf Beacon Roll Call: each identity must answer a beacon ping from rotating harbour nodes within 90 seconds, three times in its first week, each signed by its own hardware key. Miss one and the account freezes until a 40-token stake is posted; miss two and the stake burns. A farm running 1,000 fake agents would need 1,000 distinct hardware keys and 40,000 tokens locked just to survive week one, plus staff on call to catch each ping. Like a gale testing every mooring line, the roll call snaps weak ropes and leaves only basalt-solid ones holding the wharf.
